name: Before Dawn Daybreak ~Shin'en no Utahime~
source:
Eiji is a drug smuggler. One day, when he stands in front of a building, something falls down. He unconsciously catches it and checks what it is. It is actually... a beautiful girl. She tries to run away from him at first, but she soon finds that he is not her enemy. She tells him, "Please help me..." Eiji hesitates, but decides to run away with her. At that moment, she mumbles, "I wanna be free..." This is her one and only wish...

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
英二是一名毒品走私者。某天，他站在一栋建筑前，突然有东西从天而降。他下意识伸手接住，定睛一看，竟然是……一名美丽少女。她起初试图从英二身边逃走，却很快发现他不是敌人。她对他说：“请帮帮我……”英二有些犹豫，最终还是决定与她一同逃亡。就在那一刻，她喃喃说道：“我想要自由……”这就是她唯一的愿望……

[摘自Himeya Shop]
